name: kip-resolver
description: The model-assisted Layer-2 entity resolver (ADR-B12): given a hard-bounded set of candidate node pairs (generated deterministically by the CLI from nodeEids + recall, NO model widening), adjudicates each pair and returns an AcquisitionResult. A confident `same` becomes a QUARANTINED `kip:same_as?` candidate edge that no identity read consults (never a merge on a model guess); a confident `not-same` becomes a trusted, reversible `not_same_as` veto (surfaces kip:conflict); uncertain / sub-min-confidence / failed / malformed each ABSTAIN (author nothing, N5). The rationale rides along as an audit-only edge prop. Reads only its input pair set (INV-A1); only runAcquisition authors its facts.
